definition.proposition: The N1X's tensor cores run BF16/FP16 with FP32 accumulate at full rate (~1,024 FLOP/clk/SM; dense BF16 ~98 TFLOP/s at the observed 2.0 GHz training clock, ~118 at 2.4 GHz), not at the GeForce half rate
definition.refutation_criteria: fp16-acc16/fp16-acc32 <= 1.3 and bf16 >= 800 FLOP/clk/SM (SM clock sampled with nvidia-smi)

origin.source: inferred: our 72.1 TFLOP/s (notebook) would need >= 2.93 GHz under the half-rate hypothesis; GB10 community MAMF 99.8 TFLOP/s; RTX Blackwell whitepaper rates
